title: Standing Cat Water Dispenser Multipurpose Adjustable Height Automatic Dog Water Bottle Dispenser For Cats Dogs Pets Deep Gray Bottom
body_html: 1、Quick Water Outlet: Standing cat water dispenser adopts water nozzle type drinking head, ball type design, gently licking, quick water outlet. 2、Stable Base: Standing cat water dispenser adopts an oversized base design, which is stable and not easy to slip, and can hold food so that pets can eat food while drinking water. 3、Adjustable Height: Pet standing water dispenser can be adjusted in height, which is convenient for pets of different sizes or types to drink. 4、Translucent Appearance: The water storage bucket vertical pet water dispenser is sleek, translucent and easy to disassemble. 5、Premium Material: Automatic water dispenser is made of premium PP material, BPA free, safe, non toxic, and durable.Item Type: Standing Cat Water DispenserMaterial: PP1 x Standing Cat Water Dispenser
